name: DNS issue
description: Checks configured DNS servers and resolution of the joined domain.

rules.cause: No DNS server was reported on an IP-enabled adapter.

actions.label: Recommended next steps
actions.instructions: Review DHCP and adapter DNS settings. Check the organization's expected DNS servers before considering a cache flush.

rules.cause: The joined domain did not resolve during the check.

actions.label: Recommended next steps
actions.instructions: Check the configured corporate DNS servers and domain connectivity. A failed lookup alone does not identify a DNS server fault.
